message.content:
This editorial illustration features the red serif "TEMPO" logo at the top, above a headline reading "DUEL PERKARA POLISI-KPK". Two men occupy the foreground. On the left, a man in a dark suit is viewed from a low angle, with his back partially to the viewer. He gestures with his right hand, pointing his index finger like a gun toward the forehead of the second man. His thumb is raised, and his middle, ring, and pinky fingers are curled.

On the right, a man in a light grey police uniform with two stars on each red shoulder epaulet faces the first man. He is sweating profusely, with large droplets on his temple and neck. He also points his index finger like a gun at the first man's forehead, mimicking the gesture.

The background consists of voluminous, rounded white and grey clouds against a pale sky. Small white text appears at the top and below the main headline. A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner. The illustration uses soft, painterly lighting and shading.
